title: DIAL: Steerable Language Models with Distilled Instruction-Adherence Levels
abstract: arXiv:2610.31438v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a user says "Keep it short", how short should the LLM's response be? More generally, users and applications require different levels of instruction adherence, but prompting does not reliably provide fine-grained control over them. We therefore study "steerable language models" that provide fine-grained numerical control over the degree to which models follow general instructions specified in text. However, existing approaches do not jointly offer fine-grained control, efficiency, and scalability across diverse instructions. To address this gap, we introduce DIAL (Distilled Instruction-Adherence Levels) to achieve all three properties. For fine-grained control, we perform classifier-free guidance (CFG) with a frozen LLM to provide training signals for on-policy distillation of instruction adherence at different levels. translated_title: DIAL：具有蒸馏指令遵循级别的可引导语言模型
translated_abstract: 当用户说“保持简短”时，大语言模型的回复应该有多短？更广泛地说，用户和应用程序对指令遵循的程度有不同的要求，但提示工程无法可靠地提供对这些程度的细粒度控制。因此，我们研究“可引导语言模型”，它能够对模型遵循文本中指定的一般指令的程度提供细粒度的数值控制。然而，现有方法无法同时在多样化指令上实现细粒度控制、效率和可扩展性。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了DIAL（蒸馏指令遵循级别），以同时实现这三个特性。为了实现细粒度控制，我们使用冻结的大语言模型执行无分类器引导，为不同级别指令遵循的在线策略蒸馏提供训练信号。为了提高效率，我们设计了一个轻量级的引导适配器，它使用基于大语言模型隐藏状态的分类器来……
tldr: 提出DIAL框架，利用无分类器引导的在线策略蒸馏和轻量级引导适配器，对大语言模型遵循指令的程度实现细粒度数值控制，同时兼顾效率与跨指令的可扩展性。
en_tdlr: DIAL enables fine-grained numerical control over the degree of LLM instruction adherence by combining classifier-free guidance-based on-policy distillation with a lightweight steering adapter, jointly achieving fine-grained control, efficiency, and scalability across diverse instructions.
